title: ChatTS: Aligning Time Series with LLMs via Synthetic Data for Enhanced Understanding and Reasoning
rationale: 目标系统；固定 patch + 5-layer MLP。当前官方 ChatTS-8B 配置为 patch=8、position embedding 开启、hidden=4096。

title: ModernTCN: A Modern Pure Convolution Structure for General Time Series Analysis
rationale: 大核 depthwise Conv1d；单尺度裁剪可保持 patch token 数，纯 PyTorch 友好。

title: Unlocking the Power of LSTM for Long Term Time Series Forecasting
rationale: P-sLSTM 明确在 patch 轴递归；输出状态可直接对齐 LLM。

title: Bi-Mamba+: Bidirectional Mamba for Time Series Forecasting
rationale: channel-independent 路径沿 temporal patches 双向扫描；状态与自定义 CUDA 依赖需披露。

title: A Time Series is Worth 64 Words: Long-term Forecasting with Transformers
rationale: 固定 patch + 全局 self-attention；接口贴合，适合强对照但新颖性不足。

title: TimeMixer++: A General Time Series Pattern Machine for Universal Predictive Analysis
rationale: 多尺度时频系统，能力证据强，但不是简单 encoder block 替换。

title: ITFormer: Bridging Time Series and Natural Language for Multi-Modal QA with Large-Scale Multitask Dataset
rationale: 直接 TS-QA 最近邻；核心是 query-conditioned cross-modal fusion，不是纯 encoder swap。

title: OpenTSLM: Time-Series Language Models for Reasoning over Multivariate Medical Text- and Time-Series Data
rationale: SoftPrompt 与 Flamingo 两种融合；改动 LLM cross-attention，超出本轮边界。

title: TsLLM: Augmenting LLMs for General Time Series Understanding and Prediction
rationale: 仍以 per-patch MLP 为基础并加入 VAE/scale/cross-attention adapter，训练复杂。

title: DualMamba: a patch-based model with dual mamba for long-term time series forecasting
rationale: 局部 patch 内与全局 patch 间双 Mamba；正式但双分支与融合比本轮主选更复杂。

title: LightGTS: A Lightweight General Time Series Forecasting Model
rationale: 核心是周期 tokenizer + decoder；token 数随周期变化，不能保留当前 patch_cnt。

title: TimeBase: The Power of Minimalism in Efficient Long-term Time Series Forecasting
rationale: basis/segment forecasting 偏任务 head，不是通用 drop-in encoder。

title: S-Mamba: Is Mamba Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
rationale: 主要沿变量 token 轴扫描；单变量 ChatTS 场景无法直接建模时间 patch。

title: ms-Mamba: Multi-Scale Mamba for Time-Series Forecasting
rationale: 多采样率 Mamba 仍基于变量轴 tokenization；分支多且不保留 patch 序列。

title: Affirm: Interactive Mamba with Adaptive Fourier Filters for Long-term Time Series Forecasting
rationale: FFT 三频域滤波 + dual Mamba + 交叉门控 + 预训练，违背简单替换约束。

title: Pathformer: Multi-scale Transformers with Adaptive Pathways for Time Series Forecasting
rationale: 多尺度 adaptive pathways/MoE，接口与训练均显著复杂。

title: iTransformer: Inverted Transformers Are Effective for Time Series Forecasting
rationale: token 是变量而非时间 patch；目标轴与 ChatTS 当前单序列编码不同。

title: MOMENT: A Family of Open Time-series Foundation Models
rationale: 预训练 foundation model，可做冻结 encoder，但不是轻量架构替换。

title: Moirai: Unified Training of Universal Time Series Forecasting Transformers
rationale: 通用预测 foundation model；任务目标、tokenizer 与模型体量超出本轮。

title: TimesNet: Temporal 2D-Variation Modeling for General Time Series Analysis
rationale: 周期 2D reshape 的通用模型，是 TimeMixer++ 的重要前序但也需改变 token topology。
